name: OS Client Certs -- decrypt & re-encrypt S/MIME forward
description: When forwarding an S/MIME encrypted message, automatically decrypt the original, replace the raw smime.p7m blob with the decrypted content and attachments, and re-enable S/MIME encryption for the new recipients. Requires identity with S/MIME signing/encryption certificates. v0.3.14 (TEST): waits for redirected-reply initialization and verifies that re-attached files persist in Thunderbird's final compose attachment model, retrying if a compose refresh discards them.
